name: vibe-browser
description: Drive your real, logged-in Chrome from Claude Desktop.
long_description:
Vibe Browser lets Claude drive the Chrome you already use - with your tabs, your cookies, and your logged-in sessions - instead of a headless throwaway browser.

The browser can also run on a different machine from Claude, with no inbound port open on either side, by pairing them through a relay UUID.

Requires the free Vibe Chrome extension. After installing this bundle, install the extension from the Chrome Web Store and enable 'MCP External Control' in its Settings.

remote_uuid.title: Remote browser UUID (optional)
remote_uuid.description: Leave empty when Chrome runs on this same machine. To control Chrome on a DIFFERENT machine, switch the Vibe extension to Remote mode and paste the UUID it shows here. Treat it like a password: it is the only credential guarding that browser.
